subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Bold
solution:
The correct answer is: Timid.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Bold"** means showing a willingness to take risks; confident and courageous. (साहसी)

 
 
• **Example:** She made a **bold **decision to start her own business.
 
 
 
• **"Timid"** refers to showing a lack of courage or confidence; easily frightened. (डरपोक)
 
 
• **Example:** The **timid **child was afraid to speak in front of the class.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Bold'** is **'Timid'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Gallant** (बहादुर): Brave; heroic.

 
 
• **Example:** The **gallant **knight fought valiantly in the battle.
 
 
 
• **Valiant** (वीर): Possessing or showing courage or determination.
 
 
• **Example:** The firefighters made a **valiant **effort to save the building.
 
 
 
• **Heroic** (वीरता): Having the characteristics of a hero or heroine; very brave.
 
 
• **Example:** Her **heroic **actions saved many lives during the disaster.
